items.title: Ars Subtilior — The Subtle Art
items.blurb: A scrolling isorhythmic score plus the generative composer (termfx.py music) that writes its own motets to WAV.

items.title: Sophia — Aeons of Light
items.blurb: A rotating aeon mandala of the pleroma, meditative sparks and pulsing rings of light.

items.title: Maria — Rosary of Light
items.blurb: Breathing halos around a luminous core under a field of stars — blue mantle, golden light.

items.title: David — The Psalmist's Harp
items.blurb: A harp strums in a travelling wave of light over amber psalm verses in gold and lapis.

items.title: Light — Light upon Light
items.blurb: An eightfold star lattice turning in luminous gold over teal shadow. Non-figurative, honoring the aniconic tradition.

items.title: Sinai — The Parting
items.blurb: Two walls of water roll apart leaving a golden roadway under a desert sun.

items.title: Deseret — Hive at Dawn
items.blurb: A honeycomb lattice glowing honey-gold over a slow sunrise.

items.title: Starfield — a free teaser
items.blurb: The warp-speed starfield, free: a taste of the collection.

items.title: Ars Subtilior — demo motet (audio)
items.blurb: A ~40s isorhythmic motet generated with the ars composer; bundled bonus for the Ars Subtilior product.
